brief: A storage box whose lid is held shut with magnets.

requirements.evidence: Two stacked hex bases (piece:0,0,0;full + piece:0,0,1;full) forming a hollow box; 12 edge caps close all side faces, bottom closed by base, top closed by cover:0,0,1;full;top solid. Interior usable storage volume.

Top cover is solid type with integrated magnetic catch: BOM lists 6× Neodymium disc magnet Ø5×1mm and 6× steel BB mating points plus cover snaps/stack collar. Cover functions as removable magnetic lid.

finish.summary: Built 2-high hex box with all 12 side edges capped and a solid top cover forming the lid. Cover uses the BOM-specified 6 magnets + BBs magnetic latch system to hold the lid shut; joints locked.
